effect_description_eng: {Hand} [Main] If you have a Tamer with [Makoto Kuonji] in its name, by placing 1 [NightChiropmon] from your trash as any of your [Chiropmon]'s bottom digivolution card, that Digimon digivolves into this card, ignoring level. [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon. Then, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, this Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ and ＜Piercing＞ for the turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] You may play 1 play cost 5 or lower [Glowing Dawn] trait card from your trash without paying the cost.
